description:
🚀 ¿Por qué trabajar en Xepelin?
Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network, se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura.

Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos?
🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro

✨ Creemos e inspiramos

🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños

🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo

🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar

🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia

🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología

¿Qué estamos buscando?
En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

El objetivo de esta posición es potenciar la adquisición de clientes de Xepelin a través del análisis de datos, convirtiendo información clave en decisiones estratégicas de crecimiento.

Principales Responsabilidades:

Apoyar en el diseño de estrategias de adquisición de clientes, a través de análisis de datos profundo de campañas, funnels y canales para identificar oportunidades de aumentar la conversión. 
Trabajar muy de la mano con los equipos de Revenue, Growth Engineering y Data en la optimización de procesos de adquisición, impulsando la adopción de nuevas herramientas y tecnologías para mejorar la eficiencia y escalabilidad. 
Recolectar y analizar información clave del negocio para transformarla en insights claros y accionables que respalden decisiones estratégicas de crecimiento. 
Diseñar y actualizar dashboards y reportes ejecutivos con KPIs clave (ej. tasa de conversión, costo de adquisición, tiempo de cierre), asegurando que los stakeholders tengan visibilidad en tiempo real del desempeño y áreas de mejora. 
Participar en la revisión y ajuste del modelo operativo y propuesta de valor, analizando métricas comerciales y feedback de clientes para recomendar cambios que aumenten la adquisición y el impacto en resultados. 



¿Qué necesitas para brillar?

Ser estudiante universitario/a activo en carreras como Negocios, Economía, Ingeniería, o similares.. Ideal si tienes algo de experiencia en Consultoría, Fintech o ambientes de trabajo dinámicos. 
Habilidades analíticas y capacidad para trabajar con datos y generar insights accionables. 
Manejo avanzado de Excel e intermedio-avanzado de SQL. 
Capacidad para estructurar y resolver problemas ambiguos y complejos. 
Alta atención al detalle y estándares de calidad. 
Proactividad, autonomía y ganas de aprender. 
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo. 
Comodidad para cuestionar el status quo de los servicios financieros y adaptarse rápidamente a cambios. 



Nuestros Beneficios:

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres.

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin.

Es posible que utilicemos herramientas de inteligencia artificial (IA) para apoyar partes del proceso de contratación, como la revisión de aplicaciones, el análisis de CVs o la evaluación de respuestas. Estas herramientas asisten a nuestro equipo de reclutamiento, pero no reemplazan al criterio humano. Las decisiones finales de contratación son tomadas, en última instancia, por personas. Si deseas más información sobre cómo se procesan tus datos, por favor contáctanos.

title: SAP Mexico Next Gen Marketing | Latin America & Caribbean Marketing
description:
Job Description

Bring It

You are a recent graduate in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. You bring strong English communication skills and experience with Excel and Adobe Creative Suite. Some web development knowledge is a bonus, but your analytical thinking matters most.

Build It

You will support the planning and execution of marketing events and experiences. The role will contribute to delivering engaging customer and partner experiences while supporting the team in driving brand awareness and business impact.

You will also support campaign creation, track budgets, analyze campaign data, and support coordinate assets — videos, blogs, and infographics — from planning through delivery and reporting.

Belong

This team drives SAP's marketing for Latin America and the Caribbean, based in Mexico City. Your work directly frees senior marketers to focus on strategic customer engagement. You will join a global intern community with mentors, peers, and development opportunities across SAP.

Additional Information

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Our company does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.

About SAP

With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.

As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy and childbirth), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process

For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.

Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Practicante de Edición de Video (Prácticas Profesionales)
description:
PRÁCTICAS PROFESIONALES — NO ES UN EMPLEO




Esta es una oportunidad de PRÁCTICAS PROFESIONALES, no un empleo de tiempo completo ni una relación laboral. Está dirigida a estudiantes o recién egresadas(os) que buscan experiencia profesional en edición de video.




En BreakBox no hacemos contenido por hacerlo. Somos una consultora de crecimiento digital que construye sistemas de marketing con resultados medibles para marcas en México, en gastronomía, laboratorios, retail, entretenimiento y más.




Buscamos a alguien que ya sepa editar y quiera llevar su trabajo al siguiente nivel. Vas a trabajar con nuestro equipo de producción en piezas reales para clientes reales, con feedback constante.




Qué vas a hacer

• Editar reels, stories y videos cortos para redes sociales de nuestros clientes

• Apoyar en la edición de contenido de eventos

• Agregar subtítulos, música, color básico y motion sencillo

• Organizar y respaldar material audiovisual

• Proponer ideas y formatos que funcionen en cada plataforma




Qué buscamos

• Estudiante o recién egresada(o) de Comunicación, Cine, Diseño, Medios Audiovisuales o afín

• Manejo de Premiere Pro, CapCut o DaVinci Resolve (After Effects es un plus)

• Que conozcas cómo se consume el contenido en Instagram y TikTok

• Que seas organizada(o), que aprendas rápido y que recibas feedback

• Portafolio o reel con ejemplos de tu trabajo




Qué te ofrecemos

• Experiencia real con marcas activas y un equipo de especialistas

• Mentoría directa del área de producción

• Horario flexible compatible con la escuela

• Posibilidad de crecer dentro del equipo

• Prácticas profesionales con mentoría y experiencia real; no es un empleo




¿Te interesa?

Manda tu CV y tu portafolio o demoreel a claudia.corona@breakbox.mx con el asunto “Practicante Editor”.

description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

About this role:

You'll support our US-based CRM team as an Associate Producer, driving activation, retention, and conversion for our Consumer business. In this role, you'll execute CRM initiatives across Email, Push, WhatsApp, In-app Messages, and SMS, including audience creation, email production, campaign setup, and quality assurance. You'll serve as a technical expert collaborating across teams to deliver engaging customer experiences. This high-impact position offers the opportunity to lead innovation in automation, segmentation, and campaign performance at scale.

About your skills:

Email Marketing: Core responsibility involves creating and executing email campaigns across multiple channels and platforms for customer engagement.

Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Software: Role requires direct platform expertise with Braze, Klaviyo, Iterable, Salesforce, HubSpot, and similar CRM tools daily.

Marketing Automation: Building audience segments, event triggers, and automation logic is central to campaign setup and execution responsibilities.

What you'll be doing:


Ensure high quality, error-free campaigns across different devices and operating systems
Gather and document requirements, understand campaign flow logic, apply and build attributes and events, and define timelines according to SLAs
Define audience segments based on business needs and set up appropriate audiences, attributes, and event triggers for personalized email campaigns
Build dynamic, mobile-responsive emails and content blocks from scratch using HTML5 and CSS3
Implement Liquid to create targeted and relevant personalization in emails
Troubleshoot issues or errors that may arise before or after launch


Qualifications:


3+ years of direct experience executing email and cross-channel campaigns in any CRM platform such as Braze, Klaviyo, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or HubSpot
Experience with HTML and CSS for email
Professional proficiency in English


Compensation

At Coursera, we offer competitive, zone-based pay aligned to your location, experience, and role level. Our total rewards package goes beyond salary, with comprehensive health and wellness benefits, bonus and RSU equity programs, and global perks designed to help you grow and thrive wherever you are.

This role is only available for hire in Mexico City.

Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring annual base salary range for this role in Mexico City is MXN 464,000 - MXN 580,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

For more information about how Coursera collects and uses your personal information, please see our Coursera + Udemy Global Applicant Privacy Notice.

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page.

If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.

Role Title: Research Marketing Lead (Remote)

The Role

We’re looking for a Research Marketing Lead to own how our research, benchmarks, and technical work are positioned, launched, and adopted across the AI ecosystem.




You’ll work closely with our research team to turn technical work into high-impact launches that earn attention, adoption, and citations. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our research and methodology, shape positioning and narratives, establish a high quality bar for publication, and build go-to-market strategies that put our work in front of the right researchers, developers, AI labs, and technical audiences.




What You'll Do

1. Own research GTM end-to-end, developing launch and distribution strategies for research, benchmarks, evaluations, and other technical work.

2. Establish the publication-readiness bar for research and benchmarks, partnering with researchers to ensure methodology, claims, results, and supporting materials are rigorous, clear, and defensible before launch.

3. Develop positioning and narratives that translate complex technical findings into clear, differentiated stories without sacrificing technical accuracy or depth.

4. Identify high-impact research opportunities by understanding emerging AI trends, open questions, competitive research, and what matters to researchers and practitioners.

5. Shape research packaging and distribution, including research pages, benchmark releases, technical content, launch materials, and other assets that drive discovery and usage.

6. Build relationships across the AI research ecosystem, including researchers, AI labs, developers, technical communities, and influential practitioners.

7. Drive adoption of our research and benchmarks, identifying the audiences, communities, and channels most likely to use, reference, and build on our work.

8. Measure research impact, tracking adoption, citations, engagement, usage, and qualitative feedback to understand what resonates and where our work is creating value.

9. Create feedback loops between the market and research, bringing ecosystem insights back to the research team to inform future benchmarks, evaluations, and research priorities.




What We're Looking For

1. Experience marketing, launching, or driving adoption of technical research, AI/ML products, developer products, benchmarks, evaluations, or similarly complex technical work.

2. Strong track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical audiences.

3. Ability to deeply understand technical work and translate it into clear, credible, differentiated positioning and narratives.

4. Strong understanding of the AI/ML research ecosystem, including major labs, research trends, benchmarks, evaluations, and technical communities.

5. Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical and broader audiences.

6. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate whether technical claims, supporting evidence, and research materials are ready for external publication.

7. Experience building relationships with researchers, technical leaders, developers, or AI communities.

8. High ownership and the ability to take ambiguous initiatives from strategy through execution.

9. Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work closely with researchers while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy and quality.




Preferred

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Bridge, a Stripe company, is a rapidly growing business and the number of developers integrating our APIs is growing quickly. We partner with developers to understand their use cases and guide them in integrating with our APIs. We’re a small but mighty team that’s expanding global coverage and is looking to make our first Activation Specialists hires in Mexico City.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll work directly with developers as they integrate with Bridge APIs, guiding them through the onboarding process and helping them go live successfully. You’ll play a key role in resolving early-stage technical challenges, ensuring a smooth activation experience, and accelerating time-to-value for our customers.

As an Activation Specialist, you’ll collaborate across Product, Solutions Engineering, and Support teams to unblock customers, improve onboarding workflows, and ensure high-quality handoffs. Beyond day-to-day activation support, you’ll contribute to the growth of our onboarding operation- enhancing areas such as workflow optimization, documentation, tooling, metrics, and reporting. This is a high-impact role with visibility across the business, ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with developers, and improving processes at scale.

A Few Key Features Include


Specialized experts: Activation specialists provide experience helping customers integrate Bridge technology in various use cases
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, Slack Q&A to help unblock your team.
Product workshops and training for Bridge’s dashboard



Responsibilities


Proactively providing technical guidance and support to users during their onboarding journey with Bridge.
Deliver pre-built technical workshops and kick off calls to users.
Provide light touch project management for ongoing Bridge implementations and timely escalate any delays with planned go-live dates.
Troubleshooting technical issues and providing timely solutions to ensure a smooth onboarding process.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address user queries and concerns.
Maintaining accurate records of user interactions, issues, and resolutions.
Anticipating and addressing potential technical challenges during the onboarding process. Proactively propose improvements.
Offering guidance on best practices, product features, and account setup to ensure user success.
Continuously updating knowledge of Bridge’s products, features, and updates.
Escalating complex technical issues to appropriate teams for resolution.
Providing exceptional customer service to ensure a positive onboarding experience for users.
Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We are looking for dynamic and curious people that have a passion for solving global user issues, building operations, driving process improvements and want to play a front-line role in building this new operational capability for Bridge and accelerating Bridge’s growth. If you like challenging, scaled problems and are an amazing teammate, we want to hear from you!

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Bridge. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Bridge.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


2+ years of implementation consulting in API technologies or other complex technical environments.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions.
Comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Bridge works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to effectively engage and influence various stakeholders.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple onboarding flows concurrently.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.
Experience delivering live technical training to users.
Comfortable with various code-level debugging & writing of code.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

description:
About The Role

As the Global Consumer CX Program Lead (L5), you will define and drive the end-to-end support strategy and customer experience for Consumers globally within our Post-Order Consumer CX vertical, ensuring that support is not only high-quality and scalable, but also a direct lever for sustainable business growth. This role sits at the intersection of CX Strategy, Policy, Product, Tech, and Operations. As the primary point of contact for Product, Tech, and Global POCs, you hold end-to-end responsibility for the customer experience and policy design & execution—ensuring that consumer friction points are systematically identified and converted directly into funded upstream engineering requirements, automated resolutions, and harmonized policies.

Success in this role requires a unique combination of strategic thinking, deep customer empathy, and strong analytical and product instincts. You will take full accountability for the end-to-end Consumer policy design & execution and customer experience, spearheading company-wide upstream Defect Rate reduction. Operating as a senior individual contributor in a highly matrixed, global environment where influence—not authority—is key, you will orchestrate alignment across diverse stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Regional Ops, CommOps, and Commercial teams) while ensuring global consistency is balanced with local market adaptability.

This is a highly visible role with strong exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to shape how Uber leverages policy governance, AI-first customer resolution, and product innovation to transform the consumer experience at global scale.

What You’ll Do


Drive End-to-End Persona Strategy: Create and own the comprehensive consumer support strategy, journey architecture, and quality definitions across both AI-led and human-assisted contact channels for all key customer segments. 
Lead Upstream Defect Reduction (DR): Own and drive the global tech and non-tech DR roadmaps as the primary owner of upstream defect rate reduction across the company, eradicating customer friction at the root source. 
Own Policy Design & Execution (“The D”): Serve as the global decision-maker on Consumer support policies. Own the complete policy catalogue, establish universal financial impact guardrails (refund drivers, concession thresholds, cost of contacts), and lead rigorous policy impact analyses. 
Deliver on Core Persona & Experience Metrics: Hold single-threaded accountability for the overall customer experience scorecard, tracking and moving the needle on overall Defect Rate reduction, Contact Rate (CR), 1★ CSAT, iCSAT, Time to Resolution (TTR), and measurable journey improvements. 
Serve as Centralized XFN Interface: Consolidate the global performance narrative and champion prioritized regional needs through a unified intake process with Product, Tech, Global Ops, and Commercial teams—converting customer friction directly into funded engineering backlogs. 
Quarterback Persona Policies: Maintain deep subject matter expertise across the consumer policy catalogue, influencing cross-functional partners upstream and downstream to ensure policies are executed flawlessly and deliver the intended customer experience. 


What You’ll Need

Basic Qualifications


6+ years of experience in CX Strategy, Product Operations, Operations, Commercial Strategy, or Program Management. 
Bachelor's Degree. 
Analytical & Defect Acumen: Mastery of data-backed decision-making, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and connecting operational metrics (Defect Rate, Contact Rate, CSAT, TTR) to business and customer outcomes. 
Strategic Vision & Execution: Ability to balance the need for global standardization with necessary local nuances, translating high-level strategy into tangible operational network realities. 
Resilience & Adaptability: Ability to navigate complex transitions and maintain business continuity for P0 projects while building out new long-term team charters. 
Portfolio & Program Leadership: Experience operating as a Sr. Program Manager leading complex global portfolios, governance frameworks, and high-impact cross-functional workstreams as a senior individual contributor. 


Preferred Qualifications


Education: Advanced degree (Master of Business Administration - MBA or equivalent). 
Executive Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional capability to act as a trusted advisor to senior commercial leaders and influence Product/Tech roadmaps without direct authority. 
Post-Order Lifecycle & Defect Acumen: Deep understanding of consumer behavior, on-demand marketplace dynamics, retention levers, and root causes of post-order customer defects (e.g., Never Received Order, Food Taste & Quality Issues, item-level disputes, and billing/refund flows). 
Policy & AI Modernization: Proven experience optimizing and designing global policy frameworks, with hands-on experience deploying conversational AI, automated self-service, and digital support tools. 


Why This Role


Direct Experience Ownership: Own and shape the global Consumer support strategy and policy design & execution end-to-end for our Post-Order Consumer CX vertical. 
Upstream Defect Eradication & Tech Influence: Serve as the chief intake engine translating consumer friction into funded product and engineering roadmaps, leading tech and non-tech initiatives to eliminate defects at the source and drive company-wide Defect Rate reduction. 
AI-First Transformation: Lead the transition to next-generation AI and automated self-service customer experiences at massive scale. 
Executive Visibility: High-exposure role partnering regularly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams worldwide. 


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. description:
Sobre Nosotros:

En Koltin, estamos rediseñando la forma en que cuidamos a nuestros papás, mamás, abuelos y abuelas, con el objetivo de ayudarles a mantenerse saludables, activos e independientes durante el mayor tiempo posible. Lo hacemos a través de nuestras membresías de salud, que integran:

Atención clínica enfocada en la prevención
Cobertura médica de gastos mayores
Programas de bienestar y comunidad

Somos la primera empresa en México que protege a personas adultas mayores, desde los 50 hasta los 84 años. Estamos creciendo rápidamente en todo el país, con un propósito claro: transformar la experiencia de salud para las Grandes Personas, haciéndola más humana, accesible y digna.




1. Propósito del rol

Ser dueño de que la máquina de renovaciones crezca de forma ordenada y anticipada conforme crece la cartera. Que el Head of Customer no tenga que meterse a operar, y que los problemas se vean venir con tiempo, no que se reporten tarde.




2. Dónde encaja

Reporta al Head of Customer Success. No define la estrategia global del equipo, esa la marca el Head, pero sí la traduce en dos cosas: planes individuales con cada persona para dar seguimiento a su cartera y sus renovaciones, y una visión de cómo se estructura y escala el equipo conforme la cartera crece.




3. Responsabilidades clave

Gestión de personas y cartera

Construye con cada persona del equipo una estrategia individual para dar seguimiento a su cartera y sus renovaciones. No solo asigna: acompaña, da seguimiento y sube el nivel de cada quien.

Anticipación y propuesta

Siempre un paso adelante. Ve los problemas venir y llega con propuestas al Head, en lugar de esperar instrucciones o la respuesta ya masticada.

Estructura y escalamiento del equipo

Piensa activamente en cómo debe estructurarse el equipo con base en el crecimiento de la cartera, y propone cómo escalar antes de que la carga rebase al equipo actual.

Data y sistema

Tiene skills de data. Aprovecha que la información ya vive en el portal de la compañía, no solo en Sheets, para leer la cartera, detectar riesgos y decidir con datos. Piensa en cómo escalar los procesos apoyado en el sistema.

Ejecución y seguimiento

Entrega en tiempo y forma, completo. Y da seguimiento a los entregables incluso después de mandarlos, el seguimiento es parte del entregable, no un extra.

Comunicación y escalamiento a tiempo

Maneja bien la delgada línea: resuelve lo que le toca, pero mantiene informado al Head de lo relevante para poder anticipar y apoyar. Avisa antes de que el problema explote, no después.




4. Operar vs. gestionar

Operar excelente es necesario, pero no es suficiente para este rol:

Operador excelente (necesario):

Ejecuta la operación con calidad
Resuelve la operación con calidad

6. Cómo se ve el éxito

Los problemas llegan al Head como propuestas anticipadas, no como incendios tardíos.
Cada persona del equipo tiene un plan claro de seguimiento de su cartera.
El equipo escala de forma ordenada conforme crece la cartera, con propuestas que salen de este rol.

7. Qué NO es este rol

Para dejarlo claro desde la búsqueda

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US 

Service Delivery Consultants are skilled professionals who form part of our SaaS Operations team delivering services to our clients. The main purpose of the role is to ensure the effective support and maintenance of SimCorp Dimension and to all aspects of service delivery around SimCorp Dimension.

Service Delivery Consultants support our clients by providing solutions and deploying services related to the usage of SimCorp Dimension. They work closely with local and global teams within SimCorp. They instruct, coach and mentor less experienced consultants.

In this key role you will in NA to provide support & solutions to overcome issues encountered by the customer and to optimise usage of the systems for them. This interesting job offers you a valuable opportunity to increase your knowledge and gain experience on a variety of disciplines. You will find yourself working in a fast-growing environment for an international company with significant growth potential and career opportunities. If you want to contribute to our development in a professional environment - grow with us!

What You Will Be Responsible For


 You will be the key contact for our clients regarding production support and oversee the relationship.
 Establish and maintain a network at several levels at the client incl. management and be regarded as a trusted advisor by the client to promote a mutually beneficial long-term partnership
 Analyse problems and issues which occur in the solutions and the system operations of SimCorp services at clients’ production environment on a wide range of topics with professional expertise to provide convincing and timely solutions to our client within agreed SLAs

 Co-operate closely with other professionals within SimCorp on a global level by way of specialist roles to share knowledge and ensure efficient solutions for the client
 Act as a coach or mentor and review work of others. Guide others regarding general practices and procedures within own field
 You will be required to work on [NA] shift. Weekend/Public Holiday works are required on occasion. Working extended hours might also be required on occasion.

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.


 A degree in finance/economics/mathematics/computer science. Knowledge in financial issues - theoretical as well as practical

 Experience in the operation and support of front-to-back investment management solutions
 You are good at working on & prioritizing multiple tasks at the same time.

Attractive salary and bonus scheme are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. We also practice a tailored approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take

NEXT STEP

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Analyst, Digital Media Analytics who will support the measurement and reporting of B2B advertising campaigns for a global professional services client.

In this role, you will use T-SQL, Power BI, and Excel to extract, organize, analyze, and visualize campaign data. You will collaborate with Investment, Planning, and senior Analytics teams to ensure accurate reporting, monitor campaign performance and spend pacing, and identify gaps in the data.

Key responsibilities include:


Extract, organize, and format campaign data from advertising management platforms to support analysis and reporting. 
Use T-SQL and Excel to retrieve, prepare, and analyze data, supporting accurate and consistent campaign reporting. 
Maintain, update, and perform quality assurance checks on dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI and Tableau. 
Produce campaign performance and spend pacing reports across multiple campaigns and client service lines. 
Perform recurring tracking tag QA checks to verify correct functionality and support accurate data flows. 
Help senior Analytics team members translate media metrics into clear visualizations and presentations that support decision-making. 
Review campaign objectives and performance data with the team to identify optimization opportunities and potential measurement solutions. 
Collaborate with Investment and Planning teams to gather campaign information and ensure complete reporting coverage. 
Identify and help resolve data gaps, discrepancies, and reporting issues, working with relevant teams to improve information quality. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


1–2 years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or digital media analytics. 
Hands-on experience with data extraction, organization, and analysis. 
Practical experience using T-SQL to retrieve and analyze data. 
Experience using Power BI to maintain dashboards, visualize information, and support reporting. 
Proficiency in Excel for preparing, organizing, and analyzing datasets. 
Strong attention to detail and the ability to validate data, identify discrepancies, and maintain reporting accuracy. 
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain findings clearly and coordinate with different stakeholders. 
A collaborative approach to working with Investment, Planning, and Analytics teams. 
Organizational skills to support multiple campaigns and recurring reporting deadlines. 
Experience with Databricks is a plus. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. title: Diseñador de contenido digital y multimedia
description:
EMPRESA Plaza Comercial

UBICACIÓN Centro de Monterrey, Nuevo León

MODALIDAD Presencial

ÁREA Marketing y Comunicación

REPORTA A Coordinador(a) de Marketing y administrador

COLABORA CON Diseñadora, influencer invitada y locatarios




Contexto de la plaza

La plaza va dirigida a un mercado urbano de experiencias en el Centro de Monterrey con giros de tecnología, servicios y reparaciones, moda, accesorios y gastronomía. Compite con plazas grandes de precio y volumen que casi no tienen presencia digital como destino. Esa es nuestra oportunidad: el contenido debe llevar gente a la plaza y mostrar a los locatarios y a los futuros arrendatarios es el lugar donde se vende.




Objetivo del puesto

Crear y producir el contenido (video, fotografía y diseño) que posicione a la plaza como destino en Monterrey, aumente la afluencia de visitantes, dé visibilidad real a los locatarios y genere material que facilite la comercialización de nuevos locales. Reporta al Coordinador de Marketing y administrador, ejecuta el calendario de contenidos y eventos de la plaza.




Responsabilidades principales




Producción audiovisual y contenido de destino (prioridad del puesto)

· Micro-historias de locatarios: producir reels, TikToks e historias que cuenten el negocio, el producto estrella y a la persona detrás del local. Se busca generar identidad y confianza, no solo anuncios.

· Cobertura de eventos y activaciones: fotografiar y grabar los eventos de la plaza y entregar piezas listas para publicar en los tiempos que defina el coordinador.

· Contenido con la influencer: acompañar sus visitas (locaciones, locatarios, guion básico) y editar o adaptar el material que se genere para los distintos canales.

· Contenido de ubicación y experiencia: mostrar cómo llegar (metro, camión, avenidas), qué se encuentra en cada módulo y cómo se vive la plaza.

· Banco de contenido: organizar fotos, videos y materiales por local, módulo, giro y fecha, de modo que cualquier pieza se pueda reutilizar.




Diseño gráfico y marca

· Diseñar piezas para eventos, promociones, locales y comunicación institucional, aplicando el manual de identidad de la plaza (paleta, tipografías, logotipo y eslogan “seguro vendes”).

· Desarrollar material para pantallas, señalización y publicidad dentro de la plaza, y adaptar cada pieza a los formatos de cada canal.

· Apoyar el mapa digital de locales con códigos QR (ficha por local: producto estrella, horario y contacto).

· Trabajar en conjunto con la diseñadora del equipo, repartiendo la carga de trabajo según el calendario del coordinador.




Redes sociales y comunidad

· Ejecutar el calendario de contenidos y programar publicaciones en Instagram, Facebook y TikTok mediante Meta Business Suite.

· Dar seguimiento a comentarios, mensajes y consultas, y canalizar las solicitudes comerciales o administrativas al área correspondiente.

· Apoyar el programa de reseñas en Google Maps y mantener actualizada la información de la plaza en ese canal.

· Reportar cada mes al coordinador alcance, vistas de video, interacción y crecimiento, y proponer qué formatos repetir, ajustar o dejar de producir.




Comercialización y activaciones

· Producir material para promover la renta de locales disponibles: recorridos en video, fotografías de los módulos y de la plaza en operación, y casos de locatarios para mostrar a prospectos.

· Colaborar en la ejecución de campañas, eventos y activaciones de bajo presupuesto que prolonguen la permanencia y aumenten las visitas.

· Coordinar con los locatarios la producción de contenido, calendarizando grabaciones sin afectar su operación.




REQUISITOS:

· Licenciatura o carrera técnica en Diseño Gráfico, Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Producción Audiovisual o afín.

· Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en producción y edición de video corto y creación de contenido digital, comprobable con portafolio.

· Dominio de Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator y Premiere Pro, o de CapCut y Canva, o equivalentes.

· Experiencia en reels, TikTok e historias: guion, grabación (cámara o celular, iluminación y audio básico) y edición.

· Conocimiento de Meta Business Suite y de herramientas de programación de publicaciones.

· Buena ortografía y redacción para textos, subtítulos y copys.

· Disponibilidad para trabajar de forma presencial en el centro de Monterrey y para cubrir eventos según el calendario de la plaza.




Competencias

· Narrativa y criterio visual: convertir un negocio pequeño en una historia atractiva.

· Iniciativa: proponer ideas y producir con autonomía y presupuesto limitado.

· Trato cercano y respetuoso con locatarios, visitantes y equipo.

· Organización y cumplimiento de tiempos de entrega.

· Consistencia de marca y atención al detalle.

· Orientación a resultados medibles y mejora continua con base en métricas.




Se valorará adicionalmente

· Experiencia en centros comerciales, retail, gastronomía o marcas de consumo.

· Conocimiento de campañas en Meta Ads.

· Uso de herramientas de inteligencia artificial para diseño, edición y producción de contenido.

· Experiencia en cobertura de eventos y activaciones comerciales.




Postulación




Enviar CV y portafolio a urincon@inovert.mx

description:

Viva Talent · Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO




About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators, creating meaningful career opportunities for women across Latin America while welcoming talent of all genders. We’re a globally distributed team of 240+ people across 16+ countries and 3 continents.




Why this role exists

You'll build and improve the systems that connect Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, from first touch through expansion. You’ll use data to spot what’s slowing growth, recommend our next growth bets, and work with department heads to implement improvements and track their impact.




This is a fully hands-on role with no direct reports.

Own HubSpot and our GTM stack. Manage lifecycle stages and fields, data quality, integrations, conversion syncing with advertising platforms, tool access, and costs.

Keep pipeline and forecasts clear. Deliver a weekly pipeline report, track conversion rates between stages, maintain the forecast model, and analyze wins and losses.
Connect Sales and Customer Success. Ensure post-sale information is captured in HubSpot, bring customer health and usage signals into view, and track expansion opportunities in the pipeline.
Own the RevOps improvement roadmap. Identify and prioritize systems and process improvements that remove bottlenecks, reduce manual work, and improve revenue performance.
Build and implement AI-enabled workflows. Automate repetitive GTM work and validate the accuracy and value of the outputs.
Enable growth initiatives. Turn approved recommendations into workable processes with department heads, then monitor adoption and results.
Recommend growth and investment priorities. Identify opportunities to accelerate Viva’s core growth metric and recommend where to focus resources based on expected impact, speed to results, risks, and trade-offs.




Who you are

5+ years in Revenue Operations, with hands-on ownership of systems and processes across the customer lifecycle.
C1 English and executive communication skills. You explain recommendations clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and align stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
You’ve built or significantly improved RevOps systems and processes (0-1 and 1-n), with the ability to take work from identifying the problem through implementation.
Hands-on HubSpot expertise, including lifecycle configuration, data governance, integrations, and automation.
Strong commercial judgment and independence. You identify priorities, weigh risks and trade-offs, and make recommendations that influence growth and investment decisions.
Advanced, hands-on AI and automation expertise. You’ve built and deployed workflows that significantly reduce manual work and expand what you can deliver independently, while validating accuracy and results.




Helpful experience: Working in a startup or lean team; direct sales or customer-facing experience; and familiarity with Clay, Zapier/Make/n8n, and advertising conversion integrations.




Why you'll want this

Viva’s ready for the next stage of growth, and you’ll be a key player, working alongside our Co-CEO and department heads.

You’ll have the autonomy to find our next bets, guide where we invest, and turn insights into action, helping us actually create more career opportunities for women across Latin America.




We invest heavily in our people through:

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with reviews every six months and performance bonuses.
Comprehensive global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
Family-friendly policies, including parental leave and flexible support.
A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.

A focused process: application → initial interview → a practical skills assessment → hiring manager interview → final interview. We’ll share the details as you progress and respect your time.

Job Description

You will report to: Director Revenue Operations

Job's workplace type: Hybrid 

Located in Mexico City 

Position Summary

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Sales Operations Specialist to support our Sales organization through Salesforce administration, sales process support, pricing coordination, and ticket management.

You will be an important operational partner to the Sales team. It ensures CRM data accuracy, resolves daily sales requests, supports pricing and quoting processes, and helps teams navigate Salesforce and related tools. You are curious, asks thoughtful questions, works independently, and enjoys collaborating with multiple team members to solve business problems.

Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

Collaboration

description:
We are looking for an experienced channel marketing professional with a deep understanding of channel marketing and demand generation marketing and a passion for working with partners and sales teams. As part of the North America Secure Power marketing team, this role will be responsible for a variety of strategic marketing initiatives including channel marketing, integrated MDF programming, customer and partner events, webcasts, incentives, marketing communications and demand generation.

Schneider Electric is searching for a Strategic Marketing Manager that can develop highly impactful channel and demand generation programs for our Secure Power business in Mexico, Central America, and the Caribbean, that directly impact regional lead and revenue goals. This person will forge strong relationships with the Schneider Electric regional partner and internally with regional sales and marketing teams.

What will you do?


Drive the Channel Marketing strategy for Mexico, Central America, and Caribbean by coordinating with regional commercial teams.
Set partner, digital, ABM and event strategy to drive leads and opportunities that contribute to marketing influence pipeline. 
Be accountable for the execution and optimization of the marketing mix to deliver key performance indicators and targets including MQL’s and pipeline through our partners.
Engage and work collaboratively with all marketing functions to plan and implement lead generation programs.
Define and execute on partner-specific and regional digital demand generation programs that are both vertically and horizontally solution-focused.
Develop and expand engagement within the region with Channel Partners, Enterprise Customers, and Cloud and Service Providers customers such as joint marketing efforts to support demand generation.
Engage with the local partner and customer sales teams to ensure alignment on marketing initiatives.
Continuously analyze program effectiveness to optimize execution, efficiency, and results.
Partner closely with partner team to get feedback on programs as well as support and ensure timely and effective program follow-up.
Collaborate closely with distribution partners to develop clear marketing strategies aligned with corporate channel priorities.
Manage and oversee Public Relations and Media programs in the region. 


What qualifications and skills will make you successful?


Experienced in integrated Marketing and Communication with a strong foundation in digital. 
Good analytic skills of macro and microenvironments
Good understanding of IT distribution channel and its players
Understanding of relevant market trends, technical products, and solutions 
High degree of initiative and pro-active management
Able to work in a multifunctional team and with global teams and different cultures.
Open to change and must embrace the concept of continuous improvement
Strong written and verbal communication.
Successful candidate must be fluent in Spanish and English. 


What's in it for me?


High-impact role where your work directly influences growth and market positioning
Collaborative culture that values strategic thinking and cross-functional partnership
Opportunities to lead initiatives, develop your expertise, and mentor others
Flexibility and autonomy to shape how we engage key market segments

description:
About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

Community Associate | Community

About The Opportunity

As a Community Associate, you'll be the primary point of contact for the Community and act as the “face” of WeWork! You will report to your building each day to support the Community Management team.

Duties

Your work, which will include but not be limited to the duties listed below, will help WeWork to achieve the following:


Build a welcoming and collaborative community environment amongst our members through events and building relationships between members!
Ensure that your building is fully operational and processes are running efficiently.
Drive growth and promotion of WeWork-provided service offerings.
Take direction from the Community Lead and the Community Manager to support the Community Team as necessary.
All of this while illustrating WeWork’s core values and working towards achieving our mission.


Depending on the location you are assigned, you’ll either work with a variety of members from different backgrounds and industries, or focus your efforts on one of our Enterprise clients. Employees supporting our Enterprise locations may have different holidays, technical systems, operational and relationship requirements, and property management responsibilities than employees in our Classic locations.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the following areas: 

Front Desk Management


Cover the front desk during the building’s set business hours and be an on-site point of contact, easily located on the member floor or at Community Bar.
Greet members and guests with a warm and welcoming demeanor.
Ensure all visiting guests are in accordance with WeWork's guest policy by ensuring all guests properly sign-in via Welkio tablet.
Learn the names of members and guests with the goal of building relationships in order to facilitate the sense of Community WeWork is known for.
Anticipate member and guest needs before they arise using relevant information collected about members to enhance and personalize their experience.
Ensure building Specific forms are up to date including pet forms, filming requests, bike room requests, etc.
Keep the front desk clean and organized.
Notify members of any food deliveries and couriers.
Answer any questions from members and guests related to the building including way-finding, policies and procedures, community etiquette, etc.


Events And Membership Engagement


Provide feedback on programming types (based on member makeup) and evaluate events based on attendance, satisfaction, and impact on the appropriate event team.
Consistently celebrate members’ successes and milestones through gifts and notes.
Distribute all necessary info to promote the event including creation and posting of weekly events poster and individual event posters.
Ensure building-specific operational requirements are met for each event (elevators, HVAC, etc).
Input notes into Kube or equivalent system about Members.
Identify and execute opportunities to connect members with each other.
Know and recommend local restaurants, food delivery services, catering options, team outing venues, post office, shipping center, supply store, etc.
Be active on the WeWork member network to engage members.
Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures and communicate, inform, and update members on building issues.
Ensure music levels and activations are appropriate to the daypart and occasion.
Write and send broadcasts relating to building updates.


Building Operations And Management


Receive, process, sort, and organize all mail.
Locate and issue posts via the regional system to members upon request.
Keep the mailroom organized and clean.
“Return to Sender" for unidentified mail and former member mail after 30 days of no-pick up.
Ensure courier parcels have all the correct details for scheduled pick-ups.
Investigate, escalate, and resolve 'lost' packages.
Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures around mail and mailroom.
Track, audit, and organize keys collected and distributed.
Manage keycard stock and request new inventory as needed.
Collect keys and key cards upon move-out.
Review location and how to use each piece of Emergency Equipment.
Provide support for an automated coffee machine for guests and members.


About You

We’d love to hear from you if you meet the qualifications below:


College graduate with a four-year degree preferred.
Proficient in English
1+ years of hospitality experience
Customer service and/or sales experience a plus
Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
Outstanding interpersonal and multitasking skills
Demonstrate integrity, dependability, responsibility, accountability, self-awareness, work ethic, and compassion
Passion for entrepreneurial communities
Passion and understanding of WeWork’s mission and values
Proficient in basic computer skills


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

Tijuana, Baja California | Full-Time | On-Site 




Position Summary 

Superlanet is seeking an outgoing, creative, and highly organized Employee Outreach & Engagement Coordinator to strengthen our presence in the Tijuana community while fostering a positive, engaging, and collaborative workplace experience for our employees. 




This position will play an important role in building relationships with universities, colleges, technical schools, and professional communities in both Mexico and the United States. The coordinator will actively participate in recruiting activities, identify potential candidates, connect with students and recent graduates, and help promote career opportunities at Superlanet. 




Additionally, this individual will work closely with employees and leadership to coordinate internal activities, support employee engagement initiatives, and contribute to building a welcoming and positive workplace culture. 




Ideal Candidate 

The ideal candidate is personable, proactive, resourceful, and passionate about recruiting and building professional relationships. They are comfortable communicating with university representatives, students, recent graduates, and experienced professionals. 




The candidate should enjoy connecting with people, identifying potential talent, conducting recruiting outreach, and representing Superlanet at university events and career fairs. 




Strong communication, organizational, networking, and follow-up skills are essential. The ability to communicate professionally with individuals in both the United States and Mexico is required. 




Fluency in both English and Spanish is required, including strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with our U.S. and Mexico-based teams.
